issue_context.title: Right clicking on an alternative tile makes the tileset pans while opening the popup menu
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.0a11

### System information

Linux (Pop_OS!)

### Issue description

In the tileset dock, in the area where the tiles are, right-clicking and dragging on empty space pans the tiles. Right-clicking on a tile opens the pop-up menu but doesn't pan. But, right-clicking on an alternative tile (a simple click or click then drag) doesn't behave correctly. After the right mouse button is released, the menu opens (if it wasn't a drag) but panning continues. If during that state the mouse enters then leaves the popup menu, the tileset is moved far away.

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2700596/176996286-a6e7da07-3ebe-40ce-8527-c29a43ca37fa.mp4

*Note: the bottom-right overlay shows when I right click.*

### Steps to reproduce

1. Setup a tileset.
2. Add an alternative tile.
3. Right click on an alternative tile.

### Minimal reproduction project

[Godot 4 Bughunt.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/9032809/Godot.4.Bughunt.zip)
comments: Tested with `master` and the issue is still present.
Someone on the Godot Discord server managed to replicate the issue with 4a11 using the minimal reproduction project above.
The root cause of the bug comes from `TileSetAtlasSourceEditor::_tile_alternatives_control_gui_input` which doesn't correctly handle right-click dragging.

review_comments: The popup of the menu should be conditioned by `if (drag_type == DRAG_TYPE_MAY_POPUP_MENU)`. The point is to only to popup the menu if you did not drag too far.
